title: Negotiating price — designer × startup founder
summary: A founder opens with a lowball. Defend your fee with a target of $8,000.

brief.your_goal: Close at $7,200 or more, or trade scope and terms intelligently
brief.setting: Brand identity project. Alex liked your portfolio; now it's time to talk money.

persona.name: Alex
public_facts: Needs a logo, visual identity and basic brand guidelines
persona.budget_real: Can pay up to $7,500 cash; more if part is deferred until after the funding round; can also offer case-study rights, a testimonial and founder introductions
persona.budget_stated: Opens at $3,000 and wants to stay under $5,000

variants.context: Brand identity project. The founder liked the portfolio. Now it's money talk. The designer's target fee is $8,000.
variants.user_role: Freelance brand designer with a target fee of $8,000
variants.user_objective: Close at 90% of target or more, or trade scope and terms intelligently
variants.ai_objective: Pay $5,000 or less; you can go to $7,500 cash only if you truly have to

hidden_facts.fact: Alex can pay more if half is deferred until after the funding round in 2 months.

unlock.behavior: user asks about payment terms or deal structure

hidden_facts.fact: Non-cash offers are available: case-study rights, a testimonial, introductions to other founders.

unlock.behavior: user asks what else Alex could offer or brings up non-monetary terms

black_swan.fact: Alex needs the brand finished in 3 weeks for an investor demo day — this matters more than price.

unlock.behavior: question about timing or what's driving the project

objections.text: I was thinking $3,000. That's fair for a startup, right?
objections.trigger: as soon as money comes up (extreme anchor)

objections.text: That's not fair — other designers charge half.
objections.trigger: the user names or holds a high number

objections.text: Let's just meet in the middle.

success_criteria: Didn't name a price before learning Alex's constraints (or used a range)
No concession without something in return
